name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Lada race cars tearing up the local tracks. He honed his skills through a rigorous apprenticeship at a Budapest machine shop, specializing in metal fabrication and welding. His dedication and precision quickly caught the eye of a small rallying team, where he spent several years building and maintaining their vehicles. Zoltán is a firm believer in meticulous preparation and unwavering commitment to quality. 

His perfectionist nature drives him to push the boundaries of what's possible with metal. He is constantly researching new materials and techniques to improve the performance and reliability of the components he creates. Zoltán's demanding approach to his work ensures that every part he fabricates meets his exacting standards, contributing to the team's overall success. He recently joined Carlin Academy, eager to contribute his experience to developing the next generation of racing talent.

physical.description: He has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Insists on listening to classical music while working.
Has a collection of vintage calipers that he uses for precise measurements.
